title: physalis angulata var. lanceifolia
intro: Physalis angulata var. lanceifolia, commonly known as the 'Mexican tea', is a plant species belonging to the nightshade family (Solanaceae). It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, offering various health benefits such as reducing inflammation and acting as an antioxidant to protect against oxidative stress. The therapeutic actions of Physalis angulata var. lanceifolia include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiparasitic properties, which contribute to its traditional use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents responsible for its therapeutic actions include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which have been shown to exhibit strong antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities.
